## Activity

During December 2025, Market Eye Clinic recorded 426 captures. This provides the activity position for the reporting month and supports review of the service delivered at the site. Capture activity should continue to be monitored through routine operational review, with any issues affecting the process recorded for follow-up.

## Image quality

Of the 426 captures, 89 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 20.9. This level of image quality reduces the number of captures available for grading and may require attention through local operational processes. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate support route.

## Grading

A total of 123 results were graded referable during the month. The median grading lag was 2. These figures provide the available summary of grading outcomes and timeliness for Market Eye Clinic in December 2025. The site should continue to review image quality and grading activity together, ensuring that equipment concerns and workflow issues are identified promptly and recorded through established channels.
